text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Filipino president to visit Bahrain on Monday.
- Bahrain unveils 421 million dinar industrial projects.
- Bahrain's National Insurance Company posts 704,500 dinar profit in 1996.
- Jobs bonanza on way in new Bahrain drive.
- An Indian working in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, wins last week's $18 million Florida state lottery.
- Bahrain hosts an oil exhibition and confernce this month.
- Iranian foreign minister to visit Saudi Arabia on Saturday to invite King Fahd to an Islamic summit.
- Bahrain's State Security Court continues trial of coup suspects.
